notes: Version 3.3 corrects one attribution to the Foundation paper: the admissibility axioms do not force irreducibility. Under a representation-theoretic dictionary, A1 and A3 give irreducibility, and with it non-commutation, only under an additional sector reading of A3, not derived, on which a generator-stable decomposition of the fibre counts as premature selection (Foundation version 2.6, Lemma 5.6). No other statement is changed; the results of the paper are unchanged.
